offering_description.value: News Corporation sells business news, financial and risk information, general news and books to individuals, businesses and institutions. It produces journalism and radio programming, publishes books by contracted authors, and runs property marketplaces that connect home seekers with real estate professionals.

primary_products.value: financial, energy and risk data tools; newspapers and magazines; print books; ebooks and audiobooks

primary_services.value: business and general news subscriptions; professional information and analytics; advertising; property listings and lead generation; radio broadcasting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Financial institutions, corporate risk and compliance teams, energy companies, advertisers, booksellers, real estate agents and developers; B2C: News subscribers, book buyers, radio listeners and home seekers; B2G: Government agencies and public libraries buying information access and publications

end_markets.value: finance and corporate intelligence; news media and advertising; consumer book publishing; residential real estate; energy and commodities

revenue_model.value: subscription: Access to journalism, market data and professional research and compliance tools; advertising: Print, digital and radio ad placements and promoted property listings; product sales: Print books, ebooks, audiobooks and single-copy newspaper and magazine sales; service fees: Property listing and lead-generation packages for agents and developers; licensing or royalties: Rights to republish journalism, distribute data and publish or adapt books
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; product sales; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: other: Edits and publishes staff journalism and acquired manuscripts for readers, institutions and booksellers; software / platform: Turns market and company data into tools for professionals and displays agent listings to home seekers; service provider: Produces radio programming for listeners and sells audience access to advertisers

geography_served.value: global: Core operations in the United States, United Kingdom and Australia, with international book distribution and professional information sales

specialization.value: diversified: Business news and professional data, general news and radio, book publishing, and online property marketplaces

distribution_channels.value: online: Owned news, professional information and property websites and apps; direct sales: Sales teams serving enterprise subscribers, advertisers, real estate agents and property developers; third-party retail: Bookstores, online booksellers and newsstands; distributors / dealers: Book and periodical wholesalers supplying retailers and libraries; partners / resellers: Institutional information platforms that license and distribute news and data; other: Terrestrial and digital radio broadcasts
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; third-party retail; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; other

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Privacy rules govern subscriber and property-platform data, and Ofcom licenses UK broadcast radio.
